about.title: About AgriBloom
about.body: AgriBloom is a free, open-source AI crop advisory built for Indian farmers. Scan a leaf, ask in your language, and get safe, regulation-checked treatment advice with weather and market context.
about.disclaimer: AI advice can be wrong. For pesticides, always confirm with your local KVK or agriculture officer.
